Deployment Lens / Release Scope

Deployment and Release Map

How a change travels from an approved release through build, registry, and the deploy controller into staging and a canary-gated production rollout.

Reading Notes

System Shape

  • A release engineer triggers the CI runner; built artifacts land in the registry and are pulled by the deploy controller.
  • The controller rolls out to staging first, then promotes to a canary in production before full traffic shift.
  • Deploy credentials live in a dedicated trust zone and are fetched at deploy time.

Critical Flows

  • Approval to artifact: engineer triggers CI, the image is scanned and pushed to the registry.
  • Rollout: deploy controller applies to staging, runs migrations, then promotes to canary with feature-flag checks.
  • Cutover: canary metrics gate the shift of full traffic to the production API and its database.

Operational Notes

  • Canary aborts automatically on elevated error rates from the observability surface.
  • Secrets are short-lived and scoped to the deploy controller identity.
  • Assumption: a single production region; multi-region failover is out of scope.
